title: Decide whether the Wave 1 record directories are tracked or runtime, and make git status agree in every project
description:
Found by the Wave 1 integration gate (task-808869c5). .moe/attempts, candidates, checks, reviews and receipts are neither gitignored nor committed:
- The repository .gitignore lists .moe/resources/ and the other runtime directories, but none of these five.
- The init template's .moe/.gitignore lists only workers/ and proposals/.
- The wrappers' DENY tier never stages .moe/** outside the task's own BOARD path.

The result is permanent untracked noise in `git status` of every Moe project. This repository shows `?? .moe/attempts/`, `?? .moe/candidates/` and `?? .moe/reviews/` today. The delivery evidence also exists on one machine only. The held-out acceptance contract calls these resourceStore-pattern records, and resources/ is gitignored.
definitionOfDone: A recorded decision per directory (runtime state vs tracked evidence) with its reason
The repository .gitignore and the init .moe/.gitignore template implement that decision (template regenerated through the daemon prebuild), or the wrappers stage the tracked ones as BOARD paths
A test pins the template entries so a new record directory cannot ship unlisted again
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and CLAUDE.md say for each record directory whether it is committed

implementationPlan.description:

In packages/moe-daemon/scripts/generate-init-files.ts:
- Extend GITIGNORE_CONTENT (keep the existing four entries, append the five Wave 1 dirs):
```
export const GITIGNORE_CONTENT = `# Moe runtime files (not shared)
daemon.json
daemon.lock
workers/
proposals/
attempts/
candidates/
checks/
reviews/
receipts/
`;
```
- Replace the skip-if-exists gitignore block in writeInitFiles with: missing file → write GITIGNORE_CONTENT; existing file whose contents include the bundled header `# Moe runtime files (not shared)` → append any of `attempts/`, `candidates/`, `checks/`, `reviews/`, `receipts/` whose trimmed line is absent (insert a leading newline if the file does not already end with `\n`); any other existing file → leave byte-identical. Split lines on /\r?\n/. Do not remove or rewrite user lines. Do not add resources/memory/messages/teams in this task.

Error handling: do not try/catch inside the new gitignore branch. atomicWriteText is already temp-file-then-rename, so a failed write leaves the previous file intact. Let readFileSync / atomicWriteText throw; writeInitFiles callers already own error handling (index.ts daemon start ~523 and existing-.moe backfill ~936 wrap writeInitFiles in try/catch, log warn, and keep the daemon running). Swallowing IO here would hide a half-applied ignore list.

Regenerate with `npm run generate-init-files` from packages/moe-daemon (tsx scripts/generate-init-files.ts). Do NOT `npm run build` or `npm run prebuild` — prebuild runs `clean` and deletes dist/, which races the live daemon on this shared checkout. Confirm packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts now contains the new GITIGNORE_CONTENT and the new writeInitFiles branch; never hand-edit that file.

In the repository root .gitignore, immediately after the existing `.moe/resources/` line, add:
```
.moe/attempts/
.moe/candidates/
.moe/checks/
.moe/reviews/

```
Forward slashes; git on Windows accepts them. Do not touch .moe/.gitignore (DENY-tier, daemon-owned scaffold, custom header in this repo).

implementationPlan.description:

In docs/ARCHITECTURE.md File System Layout (.moe), change the attempts/candidates/checks and reviews/receipts lines so each directory is marked runtime/gitignored, same phrasing style as resources/. Keep the `see Delivery Path below` pointer. Under ## Delivery Path, add one short paragraph (not a new subsystem): the five record directories are local runtime state, gitignored like resources/; they are not committed. The evidence that travels with the repo is the git commit plus the tracked task fields (commits, lastCommitOutcome, completionSummary, reviewSummary). Reasons the worker must put on the page, one clause each:
- attempts/ — live fencing/process identity (generation, phase, host, processStartedAt) for this daemon; stale on any other clone.
- candidates/ — runner-reported treeSha bound to a local landing in progress; the frozen bytes themselves live in git.
- checks/ — wrapper-reported gate output from a disposable local checkout; the gate result is already on the tracked task.
- reviews/ — append-only candidateId binding for this daemon; qa_approve already persists reviewSummary on the tracked task JSON.
- receipts/ — crash-recovery for this wrapper's ref move (pair of .moe/receipts and <gitdir>/moe/receipt/); cloning one would hide a real landing on another machine.

In CLAUDE.md, in the `Never edit .moe/ files by hand` bullet that currently lists the runtime subset as `(daemon.json, activity.log, workers/, memory/, messages/, teams/)`, extend that parenthetical to also name resources/, attempts/, candidates/, checks/, reviews/, receipts/ as gitignored runtime. Do not claim they are committed.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Three options: (1) track the five directories as BOARD evidence and teach the wrappers to stage them; (2) split the set (gitignore attempts/receipts, track reviews/candidates/checks); (3) treat all five as runtime state and gitignore them, matching resources/. (1) is rejected: wrappers DENY .moe/** outside the task/epic/project BOARD paths, receipts/attempts are machine-local crash/fencing state (host, pid, output tails), and expanding BOARD would land those into every clone and would still fail autoCommit=false / no-git projects. (2) is rejected: the five are one resourceStore-pattern delivery path; splitting still leaves untracked noise and does not make receipts useful on another machine. (3) is the decision. A merge-upgrade of every existing .moe/.gitignore was considered and narrowed: only bundled-style files (those that still carry the header `# Moe runtime files (not shared)`) get missing dirs appended. This repo's tracked .moe/.gitignore is a custom-header file (`# Worker state is ephemeral`) and must be left alone — wrappers DENY .moe/** so a dirty inner gitignore could not land, and agents must not edit .moe/ by hand. This checkout is cleaned by the root .gitignore. JetBrains MoeProjectInitializer.kt writes a second, slightly different bundled gitignore; it is not in this task's file set because writeInitFiles runs on every daemon start and will append the five dirs to that header. Do not expand wrappers, SCHEMA.md, CONFIGURATION.md, or the inner .moe/.gitignore.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Root .gitignore already ignores .moe/daemon.json, activity.log*, workers/, memory/, messages/, teams/, resources/ — not the five Wave 1 dirs. The init template is GITIGNORE_CONTENT in packages/moe-daemon/scripts/generate-init-files.ts (copied into src/generated/initFiles.ts by `npm run generate-init-files`); it currently lists only daemon.json, daemon.lock, workers/, proposals/. writeInitFiles skip-if-exists with the comment `no upgrade logic needed` — that is why the five dirs shipped unlisted in every already-initialized project. writeInitFiles is invoked on every daemon start (index.ts ~523) and on init/backfill, so a bundled-header append heals JetBrains-first and daemon-init consumers without a plugin rebuild. Tests live in src/util/initFiles.test.ts and already import GITIGNORE_CONTENT; the existing `preserves an existing one` test uses `custom-ignore\n` and must keep passing. Stores write via writeEntity(kind) with kinds attempts/candidates/checks/reviews/receipts (same durable-first pattern as resources). Shared evidence of a landing already lives on the tracked task JSON (commits, lastCommitOutcome, completionSummary, reviewSummary) plus the git commit itself. `npm run build` / `prebuild` runs `clean` and deletes dist/ — do not run them on this shared checkout; regenerate with `npm run generate-init-files` only. Callers wrap writeInitFiles in try/catch and log warn (index.ts start and backfill) — that is the existing error handling; the new append branch must keep throwing to those callers rather than swallowing IO failures.
planningNotes.risks: CRLF vs LF in an existing .moe/.gitignore: split on /\r?\n/ and compare trimmed lines. Append must insert a newline when the file does not already end with one. A custom gitignore without the bundled header will not be upgraded — this repo is one of those; root .gitignore is the THIS-repo fix. JetBrains initializer stays stale until the daemon starts (acceptable). Do not `npm run build`/`prebuild` (wipes live daemon dist). Do not hand-edit .moe/.gitignore or src/generated/initFiles.ts. proposals/ is listed in the inner template but ARCHITECTURE.md calls it tracked — out of scope, do not 'fix'. memory/messages/teams/activity.log are also absent from the consumer template relative to this repo's root gitignore — out of scope. autoCommit=false / no-git / quiet-build-is-not-death are untouched because this change is ignore rules only.
